verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own documentation provides a walkthrough to install and deploy Bitwarden on your own Linux server, which directly delivers the self-hosted sync server at the core of this story. Keeping all secrets inside the perimeter follows from self-hosting but is not spelled out. missing for 10: explicit documentation that no vault data or telemetry leaves the self-hosted perimeter, detail on deployment architecture and requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
